sql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT geoid, n AS violation_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261026_146981' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all'
)
SELECT t.name,
       COALESCE(c.violation_count, 0) AS violation_count,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN counts c ON t.geoid = c.geoid
ORDER BY violation_count DESC, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
